messages.author: 92b7bb46cd361799
messages.subject: Grouping multiple plots in to HTML
parts:
Hi, 

I am very new to Knitr and I am trying to do the following in a R markdown file.

I have a set of names, for each name I make two plots. I need to get a HTML file  for each name, containing the respective plots. 

```{r, echo=FALSE}
for name in setofNames{
barplot(xx)
barplot(yy)
}
```

I am quite lost on how to do this. Could I get some help.

Thank you.

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Grouping multiple plots in to HTML
parts: I would try something like:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
for name in setofNames{

layout(t(c(1,2)))
  barplot(xx)
  barplot(yy)
}
```

In case you don't know the layout() function, it allows to get two figures on the same plot. Try it in the console to figure out:
layout(t(c(1,2)))
plot(0,0)
plot(0,0,col="red")
